rulings.restated: Add helper "Foreign-source dividends of this column when it has dividends; zero otherwise" and helper "Foreign-source interest of this column when it has interest; zero otherwise".
rulings.model: The restatement always enters foreign-source dividends unadjusted, and no refusal covers the case where adjustment is required. The instructions say that when the adjustment applies you must "multiply your foreign source qualified dividends or capital gain distributions in each separate category by 0.4054 if ... taxed at a rate of 15%, and by 0.5405 if they are taxed at a 20% rate," and that 0%-rate amounts are adjusted "by not including them on line 1a." Skipping the adjustment is allowed only under the adjustment exception.
rulings.ruling: Ruling: scope; a return that must adjust foreign qualified dividends is refused on Form 1116 line 35 by f1116.adjust ('Form 1116, Worksheet for Line 18'), so line 1a is unadjusted exactly where the adjustment exception applies (i1116, Foreign Qualified Dividends and Capital Gains (Losses): adjustment exception). The render review sees the column line without the refusal on f1116.line35.

rulings.model: The form says "Add lines 2, 3g, 4a, 4b, and 5," but the restatement adds only lines 3g and 4a, with no refusal for the rest. Line 4b "Other interest expense includes investment interest," which must be apportioned when foreign income is over $5,000. The program can carry investment interest on Schedule A line 9 (Form 4952), so leaving out line 4b, and line 2's definitely related expenses, changes the value.
rulings.ruling: Ruling: scope; lines 2, 4b and 5 are zero on every return prepared: line 2 holds no interest ('Don't include any interest expense on line 2', i1116 p. 17) and its state and local income tax is refused (f1116.itemized_unread, 'Form 1116, line 2 (state and local income tax)'); line 4b is zero when gross foreign source income is $5,000 or less ('you can allocate all of your interest expense to U.S. source income', i1116 p. 18, Line 4a) and other interest above that is refused (f1116.asset_method, 'Form 1116, line 4b (asset method)'); line 5 losses cannot arise in a dividend/interest column, foreign gains and loss accounts being refused (f1116.foreign_gain, f1116.loss_accounts). The label says so.
